title: Hungary plans to decriminalize crypto trading in a reversal of restrictions, which prompted Revolut and others to suspend services, under former PM Viktor Orban (Zoltan Simon/Bloomberg)
summary: Zoltan Simon / Bloomberg: Hungary plans to decriminalize crypto trading in a reversal of restrictions, which prompted Revolut and others to suspend services, under former PM Viktor Orban — Hungary will decriminalize crypto trading in a reversal of restrictions introduced under former leader Viktor Orban.
